text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
My skin feels a little... rough, somehow.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No... What a predicament.
My face stands out so much, and I'll end up making everyone worry again...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Especially you, Trainer—you're just too sharp.
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...No, this is no time to be laughing.
I have to do something about this... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Staring into the mirror,
K.S. Miracle fretted over a skin breakout.
